answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), validated through a TEE’s signed remote-attestation quote and an authorized policy. Cloning an identity therefore cannot be achieved by duplicating a virtual machine; it requires acquiring and provisioning separate physical silicon that runs the measured trusted code and protects its keys. Consequently, nectar, sable, and grove agents remain costly, hardware-rooted identities.
